description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Consolidated Chassis Management (CCM) is hiring a Jr. Application Developer to design, build, and maintain applications for internal and external customers. The role contributes to web development, APIs, automation, and BI reporting on a collaborative agile team supporting intermodal operations.
Junior Application Developer developing web apps, APIs and backend services, and supporting automation workflows and BI dashboards

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain web applications, APIs, and backend services
• Build, enhance, and support automation workflows
• Create and maintain business intelligence reports and dashboards
• Collaborate with business analysts, operations teams, and senior developers to help gather requirements and deliver effective solutions
• Help monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications for performance, scalability, and user experience
• Participate in code reviews and help contribute to development standards and best practices
• Continuously learn and apply new technologies, tools, and development practices

Requirements:
• Successful candidates must have at least 1 year of development experience, including some experience with SQL
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience)
• At least 1 year of application development experience
• Some experience with SQL
• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language
• Solid understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, REST APIs)
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through challenges independently, while knowing when to ask for help
• Comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to operations staff

Preferred:
• T-SQL preferred
• Python preferred
• AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), with the ability to validate AI-generated output
• Git and CI/CD pipelines
• Web and mobile application development
• Business Intelligence (BI) tools
• Qlik preferred
• Project management tools (e.g., Azure Boards, Microsoft Planner)
• Agile/Scrum methodologies
• Intermodal industry or supply chain background
